title: Tiki Tours
specs: Lea-Hutaff Island is an uninhabited island known for great shelling and bright blue shallow water
Wildlife sightings include sea turtles, dolphins, ospreys, pelicans
TIKI QUEEN is a historic paddleboat originally from Cedar Point, Ohio
Children under 12 must wear life jackets
Bring ID if bringing alcohol and you are 21 or over
TIKI QUEEN paddlewheel holds over 46 passengers for scheduled tours or private events
TIKI CRUISER pontoon holds up to 6 passengers for private charters

options.name: Guided History and Nature Tour
options.detail: Tour along the Intracoastal Waterway with history and wildlife viewing

variants.label: Tour along the Intracoastal Waterway with history and wildlife viewing

includes: Adult life jackets provided; children under 12 must wear life jackets at all times
gap: Exact prices for tours not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy a 2-hour sunset party cruise on the TIKI QUEEN paddlewheel with music and dancing. Private 3-4 hour charters on the TIKI CRUISER pontoon take guests to Lea-Hutaff Island for shelling and exploring. Tours include guided history and nature tours along the Intracoastal Waterway with wildlife viewing.
extraNote: Arrive at least 15 minutes prior to departure · Tours cancelled due to weather or mechanical issues will be rescheduled or refunded · If lightning occurs during tour, return to dock; reschedule if more than half the tour is lost · Tipping is optional and shared equally between Captain and Crew · No pets allowed on vessel · Tiki Tours dock at Surf City, NC
